title: Band, PDOS, and spin-texture walkthrough
description: Explore compact published electronic-structure outputs while retaining representative band edges, orbital contributions, and spin states.

citations.short: Chakraborty et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 146 (2024), 34811–34821

guide.action: Upload the three data/bands files as one dataset. Inspect Loaded Data Sets, generate a band plot, then use Excel export with offsets -1,0,1 and the desired segments.
Upload all six data/pdos files together and inspect orbital contributions. Try PbI = Pb(s) + Pb(p) + I.
Upload data/spin/spin_texture.dat and inspect retained states 1929 and 1930. This is a sampled fixture, not a complete spin grid.
